<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
unflatten(leaves: List[Any], treespec: TreeSpec) -> Any
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Rebuild a pytree from leaves and a `TreeSpec`.

Exact inverse of `flatten`: consumes leaves in pre-order and
rebuilds containers per `treespec`.

## Parameters

- `leaves` · `List[Any]` — The flat list of leaf values (consumed in order).

- `treespec` · `TreeSpec` — The structural description to rebuild.

## Returns

- `Any` — The rebuilt pytree.

## Raises

- `ValueError` — If the number of leaves does not match the spec.
